TABLE oauth_grants
  access text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'propose'::text
  agent_id text NOT NULL
  client_host text
  client_id text NOT NULL
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  grant_id text NOT NULL
  last_used_at timestamp with time zone
  name text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  owner text NOT NULL
  revoked_at timestamp with time zone
  revoked_by text
  workspace_scope ARRAY
  CONSTRAINT oauth_grants_access_check CHECK ((access = ANY (ARRAY['read'::text, 'propose'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT oauth_grants_agent_id_key UNIQUE (agent_id)
  CONSTRAINT oauth_grants_owner_fkey FOREIGN KEY (owner) REFERENCES users(alias) ON DELETE CASCADE
  CONSTRAINT oauth_grants_pkey PRIMARY KEY (grant_id)
  INDEX oauth_grants_agent_id_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX oauth_grants_agent_id_key ON public.oauth_grants USING btree (agent_id)
  INDEX oauth_grants_live_uniq CREATE UNIQUE INDEX oauth_grants_live_uniq ON public.oauth_grants USING btree (owner, client_id) WHERE (revoked_at IS NULL)
  INDEX oauth_grants_owner_idx CREATE INDEX oauth_grants_owner_idx ON public.oauth_grants USING btree (owner, created_at DESC)
  INDEX oauth_grants_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX oauth_grants_pkey ON public.oauth_grants USING btree (grant_id)

TABLE oauth_tokens
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  expires_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  family_id text NOT NULL
  family_started_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  grant_id text NOT NULL
  kind text NOT NULL
  token_hash text NOT NULL
  used_at timestamp with time zone
  CONSTRAINT oauth_tokens_grant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (grant_id) REFERENCES oauth_grants(grant_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  CONSTRAINT oauth_tokens_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['access'::text, 'refresh'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT oauth_tokens_pkey PRIMARY KEY (token_hash)
  INDEX oauth_tokens_expiry_idx CREATE INDEX oauth_tokens_expiry_idx ON public.oauth_tokens USING btree (expires_at)
  INDEX oauth_tokens_family_idx CREATE INDEX oauth_tokens_family_idx ON public.oauth_tokens USING btree (family_id)
  INDEX oauth_tokens_grant_idx CREATE INDEX oauth_tokens_grant_idx ON public.oauth_tokens USING btree (grant_id)
  INDEX oauth_tokens_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX oauth_tokens_pkey ON public.oauth_tokens USING btree (token_hash)

TABLE oidc_flows
  binding_hash text NOT NULL
  code_verifier text NOT NULL
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  expires_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  link_alias text
  nonce text NOT NULL
  prompt text
  redirect_uri text NOT NULL
  return_to text NOT NULL
  state text NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT oidc_flows_link_alias_fkey FOREIGN KEY (link_alias) REFERENCES users(alias) ON DELETE CASCADE
  CONSTRAINT oidc_flows_pkey PRIMARY KEY (state)
  CONSTRAINT oidc_flows_prompt_check CHECK ((prompt = ANY (ARRAY['none'::text, 'select_account'::text])))
  INDEX oidc_flows_expiry_idx CREATE INDEX oidc_flows_expiry_idx ON public.oidc_flows USING btree (expires_at)
  INDEX oidc_flows_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX oidc_flows_pkey ON public.oidc_flows USING btree (state)

TABLE oidc_tickets
  alias text
  binding_hash text NOT NULL
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  email text
  expires_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  issuer text
  kind text NOT NULL
  name text
  preferred_username text
  return_to text NOT NULL
  sub text
  ticket_hash text NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT oidc_tickets_alias_fkey FOREIGN KEY (alias) REFERENCES users(alias) ON DELETE CASCADE
  CONSTRAINT oidc_tickets_check CHECK ((((kind = 'session'::text) AND (alias IS NOT NULL) AND (sub IS NULL) AND (issuer IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'first_visit'::text) AND (alias IS NULL) AND (sub IS NOT NULL) AND (issuer IS NOT NULL))))
  CONSTRAINT oidc_tickets_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['session'::text, 'first_visit'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT oidc_tickets_pkey PRIMARY KEY (ticket_hash)
  INDEX oidc_tickets_expiry_idx CREATE INDEX oidc_tickets_expiry_idx ON public.oidc_tickets USING btree (expires_at)
  INDEX oidc_tickets_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX oidc_tickets_pkey ON public.oidc_tickets USING btree (ticket_hash)

TABLE password_resets
  alias text NOT NULL
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  created_by text NOT NULL
  expires_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  token_hash text NOT NULL
  used_at timestamp with time zone
  CONSTRAINT password_resets_alias_fkey FOREIGN KEY (alias) REFERENCES users(alias) ON DELETE CASCADE
  CONSTRAINT password_resets_pkey PRIMARY KEY (token_hash)
  INDEX password_resets_alias_idx CREATE INDEX password_resets_alias_idx ON public.password_resets USING btree (alias)
  INDEX password_resets_expiry_idx CREATE INDEX password_resets_expiry_idx ON public.password_resets USING btree (expires_at)
  INDEX password_resets_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX password_resets_pkey ON public.password_resets USING btree (token_hash)

TABLE refresh_sessions
  alias text NOT NULL
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  expires_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  id text NOT NULL
  replaced_by text
  revoked_at timestamp with time zone
  token_hash text NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT refresh_sessions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CONSTRAINT refresh_sessions_token_hash_key UNIQUE (token_hash)
  INDEX refresh_sessions_alias_idx CREATE INDEX refresh_sessions_alias_idx ON public.refresh_sessions USING btree (alias)
  INDEX refresh_sessions_expiry_idx CREATE INDEX refresh_sessions_expiry_idx ON public.refresh_sessions USING btree (expires_at)
  INDEX refresh_sessions_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX refresh_sessions_pkey ON public.refresh_sessions USING btree (id)
  INDEX refresh_sessions_token_hash_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX refresh_sessions_token_hash_key ON public.refresh_sessions USING btree (token_hash)

TABLE schema_migrations
  applied_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  checksum text NOT NULL
  filename text NOT NULL
  id integer NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT schema_migrations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  INDEX schema_migrations_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schema_migrations_pkey ON public.schema_migrations USING btree (id)

TABLE share_links
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  created_by text NOT NULL
  doc_id text NOT NULL
  expires_at timestamp with time zone
  revoked_at timestamp with time zone
  role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'viewer'::text
  token_hash text NOT NULL
  workspace_id text NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT share_links_doc_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (doc_id) REFERENCES docs(doc_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  CONSTRAINT share_links_pkey PRIMARY KEY (token_hash)
  CONSTRAINT share_links_role_check CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['viewer'::text, 'commenter'::text, 'editor'::text])))
  INDEX share_links_doc_idx CREATE INDEX share_links_doc_idx ON public.share_links USING btree (doc_id)
  INDEX share_links_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX share_links_pkey ON public.share_links USING btree (token_hash)

TABLE user_nodes
  alias text NOT NULL
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  id text NOT NULL
  label text NOT NULL
  origin text NOT NULL
  position integer NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT user_nodes_alias_fkey FOREIGN KEY (alias) REFERENCES users(alias) ON DELETE CASCADE
  CONSTRAINT user_nodes_alias_origin_key UNIQUE (alias, origin)
  CONSTRAINT user_nodes_label_check CHECK (((length(label) >= 1) AND (length(label) <= 80)))
  CONSTRAINT user_nodes_origin_check CHECK ((origin ~ '^https?://[^/\s]+$'::text))
  CONSTRAINT user_nodes_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  INDEX user_nodes_alias_idx CREATE INDEX user_nodes_alias_idx ON public.user_nodes USING btree (alias, "position")
  INDEX user_nodes_alias_origin_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_nodes_alias_origin_key ON public.user_nodes USING btree (alias, origin)
  INDEX user_nodes_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_nodes_pkey ON public.user_nodes USING btree (id)

TABLE users
  alias text NOT NULL
  display_name text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  email text
  oidc_sub text
  updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  username text NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT users_oidc_sub_key UNIQUE (oidc_sub)
  CONSTRAINT users_pkey PRIMARY KEY (alias)
  CONSTRAINT users_username_check CHECK ((username ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{1,31}$'::text))
  CONSTRAINT users_username_key UNIQUE (username)
  INDEX users_oidc_sub_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_oidc_sub_key ON public.users USING btree (oidc_sub)
  INDEX users_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (alias)
  INDEX users_username_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_username_key ON public.users USING btree (username)

TABLE versions
  authors ARRAY NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::text[]
  blob_key text NOT NULL
  chars integer
  chars_added integer
  chars_removed integer
  doc_id text NOT NULL
  seq bigint NOT NULL
  ts timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  CONSTRAINT versions_doc_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (doc_id) REFERENCES docs(doc_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  CONSTRAINT versions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (doc_id, seq)
  INDEX versions_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX versions_pkey ON public.versions USING btree (doc_id, seq)

TABLE webhooks
  active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  created_by text NOT NULL
  events ARRAY NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::text[]
  failures integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  folder_id text
  last_delivery_at timestamp with time zone
  last_status integer
  secret text NOT NULL
  url text NOT NULL
  webhook_id text NOT NULL
  workspace_id text NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT webhooks_folder_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (folder_id) REFERENCES folders(folder_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  CONSTRAINT webhooks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (webhook_id)
  CONSTRAINT webhooks_workspace_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  INDEX webhooks_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX webhooks_pkey ON public.webhooks USING btree (webhook_id)
  INDEX webhooks_ws_idx CREATE INDEX webhooks_ws_idx ON public.webhooks USING btree (workspace_id)

TABLE workspace_events
  actor text NOT NULL
  actor_kind text NOT NULL
  at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  doc_id text
  id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('workspace_events_id_seq'::regclass)
  payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  type text NOT NULL
  workspace_id text NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT workspace_events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CONSTRAINT workspace_events_workspace_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  INDEX workspace_events_at_idx CREATE INDEX workspace_events_at_idx ON public.workspace_events USING btree (at)
  INDEX workspace_events_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspace_events_pkey ON public.workspace_events USING btree (id)
  INDEX workspace_events_ws_id_idx CREATE INDEX workspace_events_ws_id_idx ON public.workspace_events USING btree (workspace_id, id)

TABLE workspace_invites
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  created_by text NOT NULL
  expires_at timestamp with time zone
  max_uses integer
  revoked_at timestamp with time zone
  role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member'::text
  token_hash text NOT NULL
  token_hint text
  use_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  workspace_id text NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT workspace_invites_pkey PRIMARY KEY (token_hash)
  CONSTRAINT workspace_invites_role_check CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'member'::text, 'guest'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT workspace_invites_workspace_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  INDEX workspace_invites_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspace_invites_pkey ON public.workspace_invites USING btree (token_hash)
  INDEX workspace_invites_ws_idx CREATE INDEX workspace_invites_ws_idx ON public.workspace_invites USING btree (workspace_id)

TABLE workspace_members
  alias text NOT NULL
  joined_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member'::text
  workspace_id text NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_pkey PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, alias)
  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_check CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'member'::text, 'guest'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_workspace_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  INDEX workspace_members_alias_idx CREATE INDEX workspace_members_alias_idx ON public.workspace_members USING btree (alias, joined_at)
  INDEX workspace_members_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspace_members_pkey ON public.workspace_members USING btree (workspace_id, alias)
  INDEX workspace_members_ws_role_idx CREATE INDEX workspace_members_ws_role_idx ON public.workspace_members USING btree (workspace_id, role)

TABLE workspaces
  agent_instructions text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  default_doc_access text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'workspace_edit'::text
  embedding_backfill_at timestamp with time zone
  embedding_backfill_cursor text
  import_started_at timestamp with time zone
  name text NOT NULL
  workspace_id text NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT workspaces_pkey PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id)
  INDEX workspaces_embedding_backfill_idx CREATE INDEX workspaces_embedding_backfill_idx ON public.workspaces USING btree (embedding_backfill_at) WHERE (embedding_backfill_at IS NOT NULL)
  INDEX workspaces_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_pkey ON public.workspaces USING btree (workspace_id)
